About Moon Koradji Rec.

Independent psychedelic music label Moon Koradji Records was founded in Ukraine in 2007 by Oleksandr Nikiienko, aka DJ Omsun. The label follows its main purpose: to discover, collect, release, and produce high-quality music stuff for those, who appreciate the mysteries of psychedelic sound. Read More »
